verdict.rationale: Baseten has its own deprecation page for Model APIs (baseten-docs-12, baseten-docs-43), but it only tells users to migrate to a dedicated deployment with the deprecated model weights. That covers deprecation of hosted models, not of API versions, so it reaches only part of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of versioned API endpoints or version pinning; a stated deprecation policy with notice periods, timelines or sunset guarantees; changelog or breaking-change commitments; independent corroboration.
